blocks.text: O'zbekchada harakat va joy qo'shimcha bilan farqlanadi: bank**ka** boraman (qayerga?) — bank**da** ishlayman (qayerda?) — bank**ka kirdim** (ichiga). Ingliz tilida bularga uch xil vosita mos keladi: manzil — **to**, joy — **at / in**, ichkariga harakat — **into**. Asosiy qoidalar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 108-dars — to / in / at; 110-dars — into / out of). Bu darsda nozik joylarni ko'ramiz: **to** qo'yilmaydigan so'zlar (home, abroad, visit, reach), **arrive in / at** va **get to**, **been to** va **been in**, **into** ning qo'shimcha ma'nolari va transportga chiqish-tushish (get on / get into).

rows: go **into** the bank, jump **into** the pool
arrive **in** Paris, **at** the airport; get **to** work

blocks.text: **to** harakat fe'llaridan keyin manzilni ko'rsatadi: go, come, fly, drive, walk, travel, move, return **to**; biror narsa yoki kishini yuborish va olib borish: send, take, bring **to**. Otlar bilan ham: a trip **to**, a journey **to**, a visit **to**, the way **to**, the road **to**, an invitation **to**, Welcome **to** ... . Tadbirga borish ham **to**: go **to** a party, **to** a concert, **to** a wedding — lekin u yerda bo'lsak — **at** the party (→ 125-dars). go **to** bed, **to** work, **to** school, **to** hospital — artiklsiz (→ 74-dars).

items.text: Is this the right platform for the train **to Oxford**?
My grandmother goes **to the market** every morning, even in winter.
items.translation: Buvim hatto qishda ham har ertalab **bozorga** boradi.

items.text: Thank you for the invitation **to your graduation**.

blocks.text: Ba'zi so'zlar o'zi yo'nalishni bildiradi va **to** talab qilmaydi: **home**, **here**, **there**, **abroad**, **upstairs**, **downstairs**, **inside**, **outside**, **somewhere**, **anywhere**, **back**. Yana bir guruh — **o'timli fe'llar**: ulardan keyin joy to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi bo'ladi: **visit** London, **reach** the station, **enter** the room, **leave** Tashkent, **approach** the city, **attend** a meeting. O'zbekchada «London**ga** tashrif buyurmoq», «xona**ga** kirmoq» deganimiz uchun aynan shu fe'llarda «to» qo'shib yuborish odatiy xato.

rows: home bu yerda ravish kabi ishlaydi
go to abroad, go to there

blocks.text: arrive in / at, get to, reach

**arrive** yo'nalishni emas, safar oxirida **o'sha joyda bo'lishni** bildiradi, shuning uchun undan keyin **to** emas, joy predlogi keladi: shahar va mamlakat — **arrive in** (arrive **in** Bukhara), bino, bekat, aeroport, tadbir — **arrive at** (arrive **at** the hotel, **at** the party), uy — **arrive home** (predlogsiz). Ko'chma ma'noda ham: arrive **at** a decision (qarorga kelmoq). So'zlashuvda arrive o'rniga ko'pincha **get to** ishlatiladi — bu yerda **to** to'g'ri: get **to** the airport; lekin get **home**, get **there**. Rasmiyroq **reach** esa predlogsiz: reach the border.

items.text: The delegation **arrived in Tashkent** on Monday morning.
items.translation: Delegatsiya dushanba kuni ertalab **Toshkentga yetib keldi**.

items.text: Call me when you **get to the hotel**.
What time did you **get home** last night?

blocks.text: Present Perfect da **been to** — «borib kelgan», ya'ni tajriba: I've **been to** Japan twice — Yaponiyada ikki marta bo'lganman. **been in** esa — biror joyda **ma'lum vaqt davomida** bo'lish, yashash: I've **been in** London since March — Martdan beri Londondaman (hozir ham shu yerda). **gone to** — ketgan va hali qaytmagan: She's **gone to** Paris. been / gone farqi haqida batafsil — 7-dars.

**into** tashqaridan **ichkariga** harakatni bildiradi: go / come / walk / run / jump / climb **into**; **in** esa joyni: He's **in** the kitchen. put, throw, drop, fall fe'llaridan keyin ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi: put it **in** / **into** the box. To'ldiruvchisiz esa **in** (ravish): Come **in**! Teskarisi — **out of**. **into** ning yana uch ma'nosi bor: 1) urilish — walk / drive / crash **into** something; 2) tasodifan uchratish — bump **into** / run **into** somebody; 3) yangi uyga ko'chib kirish — move **into** a new flat (yangi shahar yoki mamlakatga esa — move **to**). Fe'l + into iboralari (divide into, translate into) — 136-dars.

items.text: She opened the door and walked **into the kitchen**.
Where's Dad? — He's **in the kitchen**, making tea.
Put the leftovers **in the fridge**, please.

blocks.text: get on a bus, get into a car

Transportga chiqish va tushish 124-darsdagi **on / in** mantig'iga bo'ysunadi. Ichida yurish mumkin bo'lgan katta transport va ustiga minadigan transport — **get on** / **get off**; faqat o'tiriladigan kichik transport — **get into** / **get out of**. To'ldiruvchisiz: get **in**, get **out**, get **on**, get **off**.

rows: bus, train, plane, ship, the metro

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «go to home» → **go home**; «visit to Samarkand» → **visit Samarkand**; «reach to the hotel» → **reach the hotel**; «enter into the room» → **enter the room**; «arrive to London» → **arrive in London**; «arrive to the station» → **arrive at the station**; «get in the bus» → **get on the bus**; «get off the car» → **get out of the car**; «He came in the room» (harakat) → **into the room**; «move to a new flat» (yangi uyga) → **move into a new flat**.

Qisqa shpargalka: `-ga` (manzil) → **to**; `-ga kirmoq` → **into**; `-da` → **at / in**. Istisnolar: **home / there / abroad** — hech narsa; **visit / reach / enter / leave** — hech narsa; **arrive** — **in / at**. «arrive» ni «yetib kelib, **o'sha joyda** bo'lmoq» deb tasavvur qiling.

Bog'lanish: in / at / on bilan joy — 123–125-darslar; on the bus / in a car — 124-dars; at a party, at the station — 125-dars; by car, by train — 128-dars; been va gone — 7-dars; divide into, crash into kabi fe'l + predlog — 136-dars.

items: **to** — manzil: go **to** Oxford, a trip **to** China, the way **to** the bazaar, go **to** a party.
**arrive in** + shahar, mamlakat; **arrive at** + bino, aeroport, tadbir; **arrive home**; **get to** + joy, lekin get **home**.
**been to** — borib kelgan; **been in** — u yerda bo'lib turgan, yashagan.
**into** — ichkariga (walk **into** the room), urilish (crash **into**), uchratish (bump **into**), ko'chib kirish (move **into** a flat).
**get on / off** — bus, train, plane, bike; **get into / out of** — car, taxi, small boat.

examples.title: **to**: flying **to**, a trip **to**, the way **to**
examples.description: to — harakatning manzili: go / fly / move / send / take to. Otlar bilan ham: a trip to, an invitation to, the way to, welcome to. go to + tadbir.

sentences.text: Next spring we're flying **to Edinburgh** to see the castle and the old town.
sentences.translation: Kelasi bahor qal'a va eski shaharni ko'rish uchun **Edinburgga** uchamiz.

sentences.text: Could you tell me the way **to the Chorsu Bazaar**, please?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **Chorsu bozoriga** qanday borishni aytib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: Our first business trip **to China** was a complete disaster.
sentences.translation: **Xitoyga** birinchi xizmat safarimiz butunlay barbod bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Are you going **to Kate's party** on Saturday, or are you too busy?
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni **Keytning ziyofatiga** borasanmi yoki juda bandmisan?

sentences.text: I've sent the documents **to the embassy** by courier, so they should arrive tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Hujjatlarni kuryer orqali **elchixonaga** jo'natdim, ertaga yetib borishi kerak.

sentences.text: The pilot said, 'Welcome **to Tashkent**, where the temperature is thirty-eight degrees.'
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi: «**Toshkentga** xush kelibsiz, havo harorati o'ttiz sakkiz daraja», dedi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has to take her son **to the dentist** every three months because of his braces.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza breketlari sababli o'g'lini har uch oyda **tish shifokoriga** olib borishi kerak.

sentences.text: Thousands of people move **to big cities** every year in search of work.
sentences.translation: Har yili minglab odamlar ish izlab **katta shaharlarga** ko'chib boradi.

sentences.text: We got an invitation **to their wedding**, but we can't go because we'll be abroad.
sentences.translation: Ularning **to'yiga** taklifnoma oldik, lekin chet elda bo'lishimiz sababli bora olmaymiz.

sentences.text: How long does the drive **to Bukhara** take from here? — About six hours.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan **Buxoroga** mashinada qancha vaqt ketadi? — Taxminan olti soat.

examples.title: No **to**: go **home**, go **abroad**, **visit** London
examples.description: to qo'yilmaydi: home, there, abroad, upstairs oldidan; visit, reach, enter, leave, attend, approach fe'llaridan keyin joy to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: It's late — I think I'll **go home** and get some sleep.
sentences.translation: Kech bo'ldi — menimcha, **uyga borib** biroz uxlayman.

sentences.text: More young people **go abroad** to study now than ten years ago.
sentences.translation: Hozir o'qish uchun **chet elga** ketadigan yoshlar o'n yil oldingiga qaraganda ko'proq.

sentences.text: When we **visited London**, we spent a whole day in the British Museum.
sentences.translation: **Londonga borganimizda** butun bir kunni Britaniya muzeyida o'tkazdik.

sentences.text: Jasur **entered the room** quietly so as not to wake the baby.
sentences.translation: Jasur chaqaloqni uyg'otib yubormaslik uchun **xonaga** sekin **kirdi**.

sentences.text: The climbers finally **reached the top** after nine hours.
sentences.translation: Alpinistlar to'qqiz soatdan keyin nihoyat **cho'qqiga yetib borishdi**.

sentences.text: Go **upstairs** and tell your brother that dinner is ready.
sentences.translation: **Yuqoriga** chiqib, akangga kechki ovqat tayyorligini ayt.

sentences.text: Sarah **left Manchester** at the age of eighteen and never went back.
sentences.translation: Sara o'n sakkiz yoshida **Manchesterdan ketdi** va hech qachon qaytmadi.

sentences.text: Is Khiva worth visiting? — Definitely, you should **go there** in spring.
sentences.translation: Xivaga borishga arziydimi? — Albatta, **u yerga** bahorda borishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: More than two hundred people **attended the conference** in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi **konferensiyada** ikki yuzdan ortiq kishi **qatnashdi**.

sentences.text: As the plane **approached the airport**, we could see the snowy mountains.
sentences.translation: Samolyot **aeroportga yaqinlashganda** qorli tog'larni ko'ra oldik.

examples.title: **arrive in**, **arrive at**, **get to** — never «arrive to»
examples.description: arrive in + shahar, mamlakat; arrive at + bino, bekat, aeroport, tadbir; arrive home — predlogsiz. So'zlashuvda — get to, rasmiyroq — reach (predlogsiz).

sentences.text: We **arrived in Bukhara** late at night, and the hotel was already closed.
sentences.translation: **Buxoroga** tunda kech **yetib keldik**, mehmonxona esa allaqachon yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: What time does the train **arrive at Samarkand station**?
sentences.translation: Poyezd **Samarqand vokzaliga** soat nechada **yetib keladi**?

sentences.text: When Oliver **arrived at the office**, the meeting had already started.
sentences.translation: Oliver **ofisga yetib kelganda** yig'ilish allaqachon boshlangan edi.

sentences.text: Most refugees **arrived in the country** with nothing but the clothes they were wearing.
sentences.translation: Qochqinlarning ko'pchiligi **mamlakatga** egnidagi kiyimdan boshqa hech narsasiz **kelishgan**.

sentences.text: Text me as soon as you **arrive home**, so I know you're safe.
sentences.translation: **Uyga yetib borishing** bilan menga xabar yoz, xavfsiz ekaningni bilay.

sentences.text: How do I **get to the Old Town** from the railway station?
sentences.translation: Temir yo'l vokzalidan **Eski shaharga** qanday **yetib boraman**?

sentences.text: By the time we **got to the stadium**, the match had already begun.
sentences.translation: **Stadionga yetib borganimizda** o'yin allaqachon boshlangan edi.

sentences.text: The rescue team couldn't **reach the village** because the bridge had collapsed.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik qulab tushgani sababli qutqaruv guruhi **qishloqqa yetib bora olmadi**.

sentences.text: Emma's parcel **arrived at the wrong address**, and the neighbours kept it for a week.
sentences.translation: Emmaning posilkasi **noto'g'ri manzilga** borib qoldi va qo'shnilar uni bir hafta saqlab turishdi.

sentences.text: After hours of discussion, the committee finally **arrived at a decision**.
sentences.translation: Soatlab muhokamadan so'ng qo'mita nihoyat **qarorga keldi**.

examples.title: Going **to** or being **at**? **been to** or **been in**?
examples.description: Harakat — to: go to the concert; joyda bo'lish — at / in: be at the concert. been to — borib kelgan (tajriba), been in — u yerda ma'lum vaqt bo'lgan; gone to — ketgan, hali qaytmagan.

sentences.text: Are you coming **to the concert** tonight? — I'm already **at the concert** — where are you?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **konsertga** kelasanmi? — Men allaqachon **konsertdaman** — sen qayerdasan?

sentences.text: Aziz went **to the bank** an hour ago, so he's probably waiting in a queue **there** now.
sentences.translation: Aziz bir soat oldin **bankka** ketgan, ehtimol hozir **u yerda** navbatda turgandir.

sentences.text: Have you ever **been to Scotland**? — Yes, twice, but only for a few days.
sentences.translation: Hech **Shotlandiyada bo'lganmisiz**? — Ha, ikki marta, lekin bir necha kunga.

sentences.text: I've **been in London** since March, and I still get lost on the Underground.
sentences.translation: Martdan beri **Londondaman**, lekin metroda hali ham adashib qolaman.

sentences.text: Madina **has gone to Paris** for a conference; she'll be back on Friday.
sentences.translation: Madina konferensiya uchun **Parijga ketgan**; juma kuni qaytadi.

sentences.text: We're driving **to the airport** now — Mum's flight lands at nine.
sentences.translation: Hozir **aeroportga** ketyapmiz — onamning reysi soat to'qqizda qo'nadi.

sentences.text: How long have you **been in Tashkent**? — About a month; I'm here on a work contract.
sentences.translation: Qachondan beri **Toshkentdasiz**? — Bir oycha bo'ldi; bu yerda ish shartnomasi bilan turibman.

sentences.text: Kate went **to the window** and looked out; Tom was already waiting **at the gate**.
sentences.translation: Keyt **deraza oldiga** borib tashqariga qaradi; Tom allaqachon **darvoza oldida** kutib turardi.

sentences.text: Sarah had never **been to an Uzbek wedding** before, so everything amazed her.
sentences.translation: Sara ilgari hech qachon **o'zbek to'yida bo'lmagan** edi, shuning uchun hamma narsa uni hayratga soldi.

sentences.text: Where are you off to? — **To the library**; I'll be **there** until six if you need me.
sentences.translation: Qayerga ketyapsan? — **Kutubxonaga**; agar kerak bo'lsam, oltigacha **o'sha yerda** bo'laman.

examples.title: **into**: walk **into**, jump **into**, pour **into**
examples.description: into — tashqaridan ichkariga harakat: go / walk / run / jump / climb into. in — joyda turish; put, drop bilan in ham, into ham mumkin. Obyektsiz — Come in!

sentences.text: The children rushed **into the garden** as soon as the rain stopped.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir to'xtashi bilan bolalar **bog'ga yugurib chiqishdi**.

sentences.text: A man in a black coat walked **into the shop** and asked for the manager.
sentences.translation: Qora palto kiygan bir kishi **do'konga kirib**, boshqaruvchini so'radi.

sentences.text: Pour the mixture **into a large bowl** and leave it for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Aralashmani **katta idishga** quyib, o'n daqiqaga qoldiring.

sentences.text: Bekzod jumped **into the pool** with all his clothes on to save the little girl.
sentences.translation: Bekzod kichkina qizchani qutqarish uchun kiyim-boshi bilan **hovuzga sakradi**.

sentences.text: Is there anything else you want to put **in the box** before I seal it?
sentences.translation: Qutini yopishtirishimdan oldin **unga** yana biror narsa solmoqchimisan?

sentences.text: Nilufar dropped her phone **into the canal** while she was taking a selfie.
sentences.translation: Nilufar selfi tushayotganda telefonini **kanalga** tushirib yubordi.

sentences.text: Come **in** and sit down — the kettle's already on.
sentences.translation: **Kiring**, o'tiring — choynak allaqachon qaynayapti.

sentences.text: The thief climbed **into the house** through an open window.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri ochiq derazadan **uyga** tirmashib **kirdi**.

sentences.text: We took off our shoes and went **into the mosque** quietly.
sentences.translation: Poyabzallarimizni yechib, **masjidga** jimgina **kirdik**.

sentences.text: Once all the guests were **in the hall**, the doors were closed.
sentences.translation: Barcha mehmonlar **zalda** bo'lgach, eshiklar yopildi.

examples.title: **get into** a car, **get on** a bus — and out again
examples.description: Mashina, taksi, kichik qayiq — get into / get out of. Avtobus, poyezd, samolyot, velosiped, eskalator — get on / get off. To'ldiruvchisiz — get in, get off.

sentences.text: Get **into the car** quickly — we're blocking the road!
sentences.translation: Tezroq **mashinaga o'tir** — yo'lni to'sib turibmiz!

sentences.text: We **got on the train** in Tashkent and **got off** in Samarkand two hours later.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **poyezdga chiqdik** va ikki soatdan keyin Samarqandda **tushdik**.

sentences.text: Be careful when you **get out of the taxi** — there's a lot of traffic.
sentences.translation: **Taksidan tushayotganda** ehtiyot bo'ling — mashinalar juda ko'p.

sentences.text: An old lady **got on the bus** with three huge bags of vegetables.
sentences.translation: Bir keksa ayol uchta katta sumka sabzavot bilan **avtobusga chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Passengers mustn't **get off the plane** until the seatbelt sign is off.
sentences.translation: Xavfsizlik kamari belgisi o'chmaguncha yo'lovchilar **samolyotdan tushmasligi** kerak.

sentences.text: Madina **got on her bike** and rode off without saying goodbye.
sentences.translation: Madina **velosipediga mindi** va xayrlashmay jo'nab ketdi.

sentences.text: Where do I **get off** for the Registan? — Two stops after the market.
sentences.translation: Registon uchun qayerda **tushaman**? — Bozordan keyin ikki bekat o'tib.

sentences.text: James **got into a small boat** and rowed across the lake to the hotel.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **kichik qayiqqa o'tirdi** va eshkak eshib, ko'lning narigi tomonidagi mehmonxonaga o'tdi.

sentences.text: Don't **get on the escalator** with that huge suitcase — take the lift.
sentences.translation: U katta chamadon bilan **eskalatorga chiqma** — liftdan foydalan.

sentences.text: The driver stopped and said, 'Get **in** — I'll give you a lift to the station.'
sentences.translation: Haydovchi to'xtab: «**O'tiring** — sizni vokzalgacha olib boraman», dedi.

examples.title: **into**: crash **into**, bump **into**, move **into**
examples.description: into ning boshqa ma'nolari: urilib ketish (walk / drive / crash into), tasodifan uchratish (bump into, run into), yangi uyga ko'chib kirish (move into). Yangi shahar yoki mamlakatga — move to.

sentences.text: Jasur was looking at his phone and walked straight **into a glass door**.
sentences.translation: Jasur telefoniga qarab ketayotib, to'ppa-to'g'ri **shisha eshikka urilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: A lorry skidded on the ice and crashed **into a bus shelter**.
sentences.translation: Yuk mashinasi muzda sirpanib, **bekat ayvoniga borib urildi**.

sentences.text: Guess who I bumped **into** at the supermarket — our old maths teacher!
sentences.translation: Supermarketda **kimni uchratib qolganimni** top-chi — eski matematika o'qituvchimizni!

sentences.text: We're moving **into our new flat** next week, so everything is in boxes.
sentences.translation: Kelasi hafta **yangi kvartiramizga ko'chib o'tamiz**, shuning uchun hamma narsa qutilarda.

sentences.text: After the divorce, Emma moved **to Manchester** to be closer to her parents.
sentences.translation: Ajrashgandan keyin Emma ota-onasiga yaqinroq bo'lish uchun **Manchesterga ko'chib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Nobody was hurt when the car rolled **into the river**, but it took hours to pull it out.
sentences.translation: Mashina **daryoga dumalab tushganda** hech kim jarohat olmadi, lekin uni tortib chiqarishga soatlab vaqt ketdi.

sentences.text: I ran **into Oliver** in the street yesterday — he's changed a lot.
sentences.translation: Kecha ko'chada **Oliverni uchratib qoldim** — u juda o'zgaribdi.

sentences.text: The couple next door moved **into the house** in 1995 and have never left.
sentences.translation: Qo'shni er-xotin bu **uyga** 1995-yilda **ko'chib kelishgan** va o'shandan beri hech qayoqqa ketishmagan.

sentences.text: When did your family move **to Tashkent** from Namangan?
sentences.translation: Oilangiz Namangandan **Toshkentga** qachon **ko'chib kelgan**?

sentences.text: Be careful not to bump **into anything** — the room is full of fragile vases.
sentences.translation: Hech narsaga **urilib ketmang** — xona mo'rt guldonlarga to'la.

examples.title: Mixed: a journey from Tashkent to Edinburgh
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: to, in, into, get on / into, arrive, been in va predlogsiz holatlar bitta sayohat hikoyasida.

sentences.text: Last summer Aziz flew **to Edinburgh** to start a master's course.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Aziz magistratura kursini boshlash uchun **Edinburgga** uchdi.

sentences.text: He **got on the plane** in Tashkent at dawn and changed planes **in Istanbul**.
sentences.translation: U tong saharda Toshkentda **samolyotga chiqdi** va **Istanbulda** samolyot almashtirdi.

sentences.text: When he finally **arrived in Scotland**, it was raining heavily.
sentences.translation: Nihoyat **Shotlandiyaga yetib kelganda** kuchli yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.

sentences.text: At the airport he **got into a taxi** and asked the driver to take him **to the university**.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda u **taksiga o'tirdi** va haydovchidan uni **universitetga** olib borishni so'radi.

sentences.text: The driver couldn't find the hall of residence, so they **got there** an hour late.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi talabalar yotoqxonasini topa olmadi, shuning uchun ular **u yerga** bir soat kech **yetib borishdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz carried his heavy suitcases **into the building** and up three flights of stairs.
sentences.translation: Aziz og'ir chamadonlarini **binoga olib kirdi** va uch qavat zinadan yuqoriga ko'tardi.

sentences.text: On his first weekend, he **visited the castle** and explored the old town.
sentences.translation: Birinchi dam olish kunida u **qal'aga borib** keldi va eski shaharni aylanib chiqdi.

sentences.text: His roommate, who had **been in Edinburgh** for two years, showed him around.
sentences.translation: Ikki yildan beri **Edinburgda yashayotgan** xonadoshi unga shaharni aylantirib ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: In December Aziz **went home** for the holidays and told everyone about his new life.
sentences.translation: Dekabrda Aziz ta'tilga **uyga ketdi** va hammaga yangi hayoti haqida gapirib berdi.

sentences.text: His little sister now dreams of going **abroad** too — preferably **to Scotland**!
sentences.translation: Endi uning singlisi ham **chet elga** ketishni orzu qiladi — iloji bo'lsa, **Shotlandiyaga**!
